Test input only. `sw6/` holds documents from Scientific Word 6 (MacKichan Software)
used to check that opensw reads and writes .sci files; they are not part of opensw.
They are not in this repository: to run the tests that use them, copy SW_Book_1.sci,
swwelcome.sci and template.sci from a Scientific Word 6 installation into test/fixtures/sw6/.
